listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (Zelda-Mobile (OJZen/totk-mobile))
listing.summary: Experimental Upstream explicitly describes direct execution of the game’s ARM64 code on Apple silicon, an ARM64 module rewriter, a host reimplementing Horizon/system services, and NVN graphics commands translated to Metal. Shared Mac/iOS core. This is a title-specific native-code compatibility adaptation, not a generic framework, Windows recompilation or original standalone game. This classification is based on documented behavior, not repository name/language. Upstream maturity: Upstream Mac save loading/scene play/audio/cutscenes and keyboard/Xbox control; full playthrough unvalidated, first-visit shader stutters and variable FPS. Mobile results are separate and bounded. Portcove testing Not run. Acquisition: Source build and upstream preparation on Apple silicon Mac; no official release package observed. The player’s own base game, v1.4.3 update and keys generate the local runtime/resources/shaders. Platforms: Apple silicon Mac M1+ with full Xcode/CLT and Homebrew; exact macOS/Metal minimum Unknown. Intel unsupported. iPad M1+ limited play/import evidence; iPhone15Pro title-only, gameplay unmeasured. No other desktop route. Original data: Own Switch Tears of the Kingdom base plus v1.4.3 .nsz update and matching prod.keys; exactly one base/update in local/games/. Module fingerprint checks reject other versions. Accepted base format, region/title ID, actual hashes and firmware/font/ticket requirements remain Unknown in the retained README. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
